text:
maddie (oncall): :rotating_light: Saffron enterprise dedicated pool (saffron-vpc-pool-01) reported 100% GPU allocation, queue depth 92, 95th latency spiking.
incident-bot: automated alert created: INC-20260315-4123
incident-bot: PagerDuty notification sent to @oncall
ria (sre): seeing OOM evictions in the pool, autoscaler not kicking — looks like scaler maxed at 40 nodes
anthony (infra): checking autoscaler and pool policies now, I think burst_to_shared is disabled for this tenant by default
sarah (acctmgr): customer (Saffron Health) calling in — they see timeouts and request failures, high business impact. Wants ETA on mitigation.
maddie (oncall): handing off to @ria, I need to take another page in ~7m. Ria can you run quick diagnostics and recommend burst vs local mitigations? :pray:
ria (sre): on it. quick commands I'm running:
```
# pool and autoscaler status
rfctl pools describe saffron-vpc-pool-01 --region us-west-2
# check node utilization
kubectl top nodes --selector=pool=saffron-vpc-pool-01 | sort -k3 -nr
# router queues
curl -s https://internal-metrics/api/v1/queue?s=router.saffron | jq .
```
ria (sre): summary: autoscaler max_nodes = 40, current_nodes = 40, pending_requests at inference-router = 21, a handful of internal low-priority tenants are running on this pool
anthony (infra): confirm config: burst_to_shared=false for saffron (customer requirement). We can either: 1) temporarily flip burst_to_shared to true (requires ops approval + compliance check), or 2) evict low-priority internal tenants on this pool to free GPUs.
sarah (acctmgr): customer explicitly requested no spill to shared-hosted. They will not allow their traffic on multi-tenant hosted capacity. They approve any action that stays within their VPC.
maddie (oncall): noted. Given that constraint, prefer eviction of low-pri workloads + temporary autoscaler bump if needed. Ria—can you draft an action plan and execute? I'll stay in the loop.
ria (sre): action plan:
1) mark nodes labeled "low-pri" for immediate eviction
2) drain pods with graceful timeout 10s to avoid long tails
3) patch autoscaler to increase temporary max_nodes by +4 (to 44) to allow short ramp while drains complete
4) monitor queue depth and 95th pct latency, rollback if errors increase
5) notify acct team and customer once stabilized

sarah (acctmgr): customer ok with eviction of internal workloads. Please notify when we flip autoscaler settings.
ria (sre): executing now.
incident-bot: action logged: user=ria action=evict-tag=low-pri timestamp=2166789305
maddie (oncall): tagging @anthony to watch for any provisioning failures during the scale-up
anthony (infra): starting node drains: `rfctl node drain node-sf-03 node-sf-07 node-sf-11` — will follow logs
anthony (infra): drains completed for 3 nodes, freed 5 GPUs. Patching autoscaler to allow +4 nodes (temp)
ria (sre): autoscaler patched: old_max=40 new_max=44 (temporary)
anthony (infra): provisioning new nodes now, cloud provider spin-up ETA ~45s
ria (sre): observed queue drop from 21 -> 4 within 90s, 95th latency down from ~1.2s to ~220ms
sarah (acctmgr): customer reports decreased errors, services returning to normal; they say degraded but recovering. Thanks.
maddie (oncall): great. Please collect the relevant metric windows and config diffs for the postmortem. Ria keep monitoring for at least 60 minutes.
ria (sre): will collect metrics (router queue, tail latencies, node allocs) and push a diff of pool config and autoscaler change to the incident ticket. Also adding a note recommending adding a soft preempt policy for low-pri internal jobs so future evictions are faster.
incident-bot: INC-20260315-4123 status=mitigated assignee=ria
pagerduty: Incident acknowledged by ria at 2166789340
maddie (oncall): quick follow-ups: (a) anthony please propose safe default for burst policy for enterprise pools in next 48h, (b) product/ops to discuss customer-approved spill policies for VPCs, (c) run a capacity forecast for saffron tenant to avoid repeat.
anthony (infra): noted. I'll open RFC and include rollback playbook for flipping burst_to_shared, and a checklist to get compliance sign-off.
sarah (acctmgr): I'll coordinate with Saffron Health to discuss longer-term capacity commit — they may accept a reserved capacity purchase.
maddie (oncall): closing handoff. :thumbsup: Excellent coordination everyone.
